## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the change and any user-visible result. Link an issue.

## Validation

Link CircleCI for the current commit. State which checks ran and which remain
unverified. For UI changes, include actual captures, keyboard/focus behavior,
text scaling, reduced motion and opaque fallback results.

## Boundaries and provenance

List affected backend capabilities, dependencies, permission/network changes and
copied/generated material with license/source details. State any material limitation.
